criteria.requirement: Clean checkout/worktree can build with documented Java 17 setup.
`clean build` passes.
Exactly three first-party SAMCNPC mod artifacts are produced: Core, Behavior, LLM.
Core has no dependency/import on Behavior/LLM.
Behavior has no dependency/import on LLM.
All hand-written `src/main` production source is Kotlin.
No floating dependency versions remain.
Dev client launches with all three mods.
Dedicated server launches with Core + Behavior + LLM without client-class crash.
LLM shell does not require credentials/network to load.
Player command summons an NPC and creates the correct `SummonerBinding`.
NPC persists across save/stop/start.
Dismiss/removal cleans runtime indexes without leaked references.
Two summoners can create NPCs without cross-control.
Permission checks prevent an ordinary player from controlling another summoner's NPC.
NPC uses summoner skin instead of a static SAMCNPC texture.
Two different summoner skins remain distinct.
Classic/slim model selection works or a precisely documented engine limitation is proven.
Outer skin layers render.
Missing/unavailable skin data produces deterministic vanilla fallback, not crash.
Manual/safe lifecycle refresh works without per-tick network requests.
Built-in JSON behavior pack loads and controls NPC.
External custom JSON behavior pack loads from documented directory.
Unknown action/condition is rejected with pack/rule context.
Malformed JSON is rejected without destroying active last-known-good registry.
Reload is transactional/atomic from the runtime's perspective.
Rule/channel arbitration is deterministic and unit-tested.
Conditions cannot mutate the world.
No filesystem/JSON parsing occurs per NPC tick.
Missing assigned pack degrades to safe idle + diagnostic.
Follow behavior is implemented in Behavior, not Core goals/policy.
Combat/retaliation decision is implemented in Behavior, not Core target-selection policy.
Movement/look actions visibly function.
Main/offhand/equipment state is authoritative and rendered.
Melee action can attack a valid target and does not attack out of allowed conditions/range.
Action conflicts do not create infinite start/stop oscillation within a single tick.

Animation state is driven from actual action state rather than client guesses where practical. Verified by the 2026-09-06 Core GameTests and 24-scenario real-client animation smoke; see `PROJECT_STATE.md`.
Manual assignment, parameters, status, pause/resume and cancellation work without an LLM or GUI creator, with validated summoner permissions and registered definitions.
Lumberjack selects wood species/sets, work area/exclusions, destination and quota; mixed-forest tests leave other species and out-of-bounds wood untouched.
Mining completes selected ore/vein, bounded tunnel and bounded excavation variants, with permitted blocks/volume, hazards, tool/drop accounting, return and delivery tested.
Defend protects the summoner, a specified NPC and a point/area with permitted threats, a bounded pursuit, retreat/stop conditions and correct return to interrupted work.
Attack engages an explicit target or permitted types in a bounded area, respecting friendly/summoner checks, melee/ranged policy, quota/deadline, cancellation and retreat.
Food gathering handles edible drops, supported wild-food harvest, stored food and explicitly selected hunting, with a separate retained ration and delivered quantity.
Farming harvests mature crops, prepares permitted soil, sows/replants and maintains bounded cycles; wheat/carrot/potato tests verify seed reserves and actual yields.
Tree planting selects species/positions/spacing, supports advertised 1×1/2×2 layouts, fills eligible gaps and composes with lumberjack replanting using real saplings.
Transport moves the requested filtered quantity between authorized containers, revalidates partial transfers and supports task supply without recursive job spawning.
Every operation has bounded local target/route/tool/resupply recovery, an explicit waiting/partial-failure outcome, resource accounting and tested cancellation/restart.
The catalog runs with the LLM JAR absent and with its unconfigured shell present; routine execution/recovery contains no model/network calls or per-tick data parsing.
Competing and mixed operations preserve resources and work reservations, including shared veins, crop/seed stocks and lumberjack/replanting conflicts; load is measured.
Existing Core movement/look/equip/attack/held-use calls are mapped to real tests; any missing mechanism needed by the operations is completed through Core APIs.

criteria.section: Composable behavior components — required scope added 2026-09-10
criteria.requirement: B01–B04 select nearest/filtered/explicit/attacker targets deterministically and respect summoner/friendly constraints; each damage event is processed once. Continuous damage does not prevent a counterattack through repeated target-acquisition intents.

criteria.section: Composable behavior components — required scope added 2026-09-10
criteria.requirement: B05–B08 compose real-inventory equipment, distance, retreat/healing and pursuit limits without replacing an item currently being used or oscillating between modes.

criteria.section: Composable behavior components — required scope added 2026-09-10
criteria.requirement: B09–B11 refill needs, deposit only surplus and collect allowed nearby drops within detour/time limits; shared reserves prevent transfer loops and preserve actual resources.

criteria.section: Composable behavior components — required scope added 2026-09-10
criteria.requirement: B12–B15 patrol, yield, recover locally and resume the intended task after fresh observations; interruption depth, target memory and retries remain bounded.

criteria.section: Composable behavior components — required scope added 2026-09-10
criteria.requirement: Passive/retaliation/protection/area-attack policies are explicit, and newly summoned NPCs remain idle until assignment. Every admitted intent uses the existing arbitration.

criteria.section: Composable behavior components — required scope added 2026-09-10
criteria.requirement: Real client/server integration verifies work → damage → equipment → fight/retreat → resume, plus cancellation, repeated hits, target loss, reload and restart. No LLM is needed and no stale control or completion can take over a newer task.
Summoner disconnect does not crash or spin-log.
Summoner reconnect recovers binding/skin behavior safely.
criteria.note: Binding/reconnect runtime is verified; authenticated visual skin comparison remains manual.

criteria.requirement: NPC death/removal clears behavior runtime state.
Dimension/world unload does not retain entity objects globally.
Behavior reload cannot trigger ConcurrentModificationException by modifying active collections during iteration.
Invalid packets are rejected server-side.
Debug logging is bounded and disabled/cheap by default.
`PROJECT_STATE.md` contains exact commands and results.
`scripts/verify_boundaries.py` passes.
`scripts/verify_distribution.py` passes after build.
Known limitations are separated from unverified claims.

BUILD.scope: Canonical clean build: 518 units and seven Python guard tests, source/Core/distribution checks; 850 unchanged frozen inputs. Standalone clean build: 105 LLM tests and 122 matching own sources. Fresh standalone client/server loading passed.

PACKAGING.scope: Exactly three Java-17 first-party JARs; compiled src/test classes absent and no cross-module implementation classes bundled. Core/Behavior built-in Forge GameTests are developer fixtures, distinct from test-only smoke drivers.

CORE.scope: 146 native Core cases; latest Core production and build hash identity retained by planner/evaluation/hour manifests.

BEHAVIOR.scope: 215 native Behavior cases with no LLM dependency; same current Behavior production/build.

CLIENT.scope: Latest 52 Core rendered animation scenarios retained; all-mode LLM client/server physical probes and config/logo GUI on exact current production. Earlier twelve operation-client cases retain their recorded mechanic scope.

LLM.scope: Translator 8/9, Supervisor 14/22, Planner 6/9 cases/HTTP per side; all three two-JVM restart suites, 37 admission and 15 authority checks. Real model semantics remain deferred.

CATALOG.scope: Sixteen published typed families, parameter schema/descriptor conformance and existing P11 validation/reload/public control evidence.

RESTART.scope: 24 Behavior ordinary-save checkpoints and 19 lifecycle cases in the Z8 source scope; current exact-task LLM save/recovery suites. No abrupt-crash atomicity claim.

COMPONENTS.scope: Per-point B01-B15/native/client/resource tests; current 364 Behavior units and 215 native regressions. Earlier dedicated client/runtime proofs retain their original source scope.

ZOO.scope: 23/23 Zoo points, eight families, 660 completed tasks in 3641.1122805 active seconds/72828 ticks. Historical source; not rerun by the LLM patrol benchmark.

HOUR.scope: Six native NPCs, 3600.046 active seconds /72001 ticks, six completed patrols, twelve HTTP calls and twenty minutes of actual endpoint shutdown; zero retained workers. PATROL/melee profile, separate from product goal modes and historical mixed Zoo.

SKINS.scope: User decision 2026-09-20: two genuine authenticated accounts, skin variants/layers/refresh/reconnect/restart remain a human test. Automated signed-profile/render/fallback fixtures retained separately.

DOCS.scope: Criteria mapping, exact commands, installation, configuration, secrets, persistence compatibility, model limits, manual skin procedure and three-artifact hashes are recorded.

manualException: Skin manual test does not block P10/P12 or release preparation; no skin criterion is silently marked passed.
runtimeScope: The LLM hour uses restricted PATROL/melee policy. Product modes, all operation mechanics and earlier mixed Zoo are separate proofs.
